responsibility: Provides the top-level dispatcher for diagnostics subsystem selftests. Rather than implementing a feature of diagnostic emission itself, this file groups together and runs the per-file test suites for color handling, file caching, source printing, HTML and SARIF sinks, digraphs, output-spec parsing, state graphs, lazy paths, path output, and fix-it change application, while intentionally leaving context_cc_tests to be run from language-specific test entry points.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the diagnostics-selftests pair: it defines run_diagnostics_selftests and actually invokes the per-file diagnostics test families, intentionally excluding context_cc_tests from this umbrella runner. In contrast, diagnostics-selftests.h only declares the runner and the individual test entry points.
